text:
Rae: Draft release notes for v1.14 up for review. This is a low-risk runtime tweak with a conservative canary. Need ops + legal quick ack before we schedule the announce. Planned start 2025-07-10T16:00:00Z. Pin: runtime v3.2.2, fallback v3.2.1.

Rae: Release note bullets:
- Runtime: inference-runtime v3.2.2 (bugfix: KV eviction handling + minor scheduler improvement).
- Models: no default model map changes; small models get experimental quant profile (opt-in).
- Canary: staged rollout 8% -> 25% -> 100% over ~100m.
- Rollback: auto fallback to v3.2.1 if 5xx > 2x baseline AND >= 25 errors/min sustained for 10m, or p95 latency > baseline*2 for 10m.
- Observability: added per-route token-cost and a toggle to surface quant mismatches in traces.

Jon: Small ask: can we make initial canary 8% instead of 5%? DB skew in one region makes 5% too noisy. Ops prefers 8%.

Priya: Legal: wording for telemetry is fine. Added a one-liner in the blurb re: opt-in quant models and customer-impact.

Rae: Updated: canary steps 8%,25%,100% and note about cache warmup: "Expect slightly elevated p95 for first 20m of each step while KV warms."

mitra-bot: Suggested deploy command snippet based on inputs.

Rae: Deploybot command (ops run T-10m):
```
/deploy schedule --release v1.14 --canary 8% --steps "8%,25%,100%" --step-duration 30m --start 2025-07-10T16:00:00Z --pin runtime=v3.2.2 --fallback runtime=v3.2.1 --alerts "5xx,p95"
```

Rae: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploys/v1.14 (preflight: smoke tests, cost delta check, traffic seed).

Jon: I'll run smoke + cost script at T-35m. I'll also seed 1k requests to the canary pool at T-15m.

Priya: I'll prepare the internal announcement copy and include the legal-approved telemetry blurb. Where do we post? #company? and pin RN to docs?

Rae: Yes post to #company after first canary step looks stable (~15m after start). Pin RN in eng docs and add trace links in the announcement.

deploybot: Deployment scheduled by rae 2025-07-10T16:00:00Z release=v1.14 steps=[8%,25%,100%] step_duration=30m pin=runtime:v3.2.2 fallback=runtime:v3.2.1 alerts=[5xx,p95] runbook=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploys/v1.14

Jon: :thumbsup: smoke shows green on staging at 15:25 UTC. Cost delta ~1.8% on embed-heavy traces.

Priya: :thumbsup: blurb ready and pinned draft at https://redwood.internal/rn/1.14-draft. Adding sales note about cost impact.

Rae: Great. React with :eyes: when you have control checks done. I'll blast internal announce 16:20 UTC if 8% canary stable. If anything odd, fallback and page on-call.

Jon: :eyes: preflight complete. Seeding scheduled.

Priya: :eyes: legal + sales lines in place.

Rae: Closing thread unless blockers.
